execution.startingPosition: Take a shoulder-width closed overhand grip on a horizontal pull-up bar, fully extend both elbows, and lift your feet clear of the floor.
execution.movement: Pull your shoulders slightly away from your ears and hold the shoulder blades down without bending your elbows.
execution.endpoint: Hold the active suspended position for the set time without losing the grip or shoulder position.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep both elbows fully extended and keep the shoulder blades down without repeatedly raising and lowering them.
execution.supportAndPosture: Support your full bodyweight through both hands with no foot assistance and no deliberate swing.
disqualifyingCompensations: Letting the shoulders rise toward the ears turns the exercise into a Passive Dead Hang.
Bending the elbows turns the exercise into a flexed-arm hold.
Repeatedly raising and lowering the shoulders turns the exercise into a shoulder-blade pull-up.

execution.startingPosition: Sit comfortably with the working foot resting on a board beneath an elastic band affixed to that board. Set a physical stop where the working foot reaches its comfortable lifted position. Begin from the self-selected resting position with the sole on the board.
execution.movement: Lift the front of the foot toward the shin until it reaches the stop, without turning the foot inward or outward or lifting through the toes alone.
execution.endpoint: End the lift when the foot reaches the physical stop.
execution.returnPhase: Return under control until the sole touches the board.
execution.controlledJoints: Hold the selected knee posture still.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stay seated and supported by the seat while only the working foot moves.
disqualifyingCompensations: Bending or straightening the knee to swing the foot up turns the ankle lift into a leg swing.
Turning the foot inward or outward turns the ankle lift into a twisting foot movement.
Lifting through the toes alone turns the ankle lift into a toe raise.
execution.sideOrDirection: Complete every repetition before changing sides, then repeat with the other foot.

execution.startingPosition: Stand in a single-leg calf-raise machine with the front of the working foot centered on the platform and your shoulder beneath the load pad.
execution.movement: Raise the heel as high as you can.
execution.endpoint: Finish at the highest heel position you can reach.
execution.returnPhase: Lower under control without bending the knee or curling the toes.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the working knee straight and hold your hips, back, knee, and foot steady.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stand tall on the machine platform with the load pad resting on your shoulder.
disqualifyingCompensations: Bending and straightening the knee turns the calf raise into a knee-driven bounce.
Curling the toes turns the calf raise into a toe-flexion exercise.
execution.sideOrDirection: Finish the set on the working side, then repeat with the other leg.

execution.startingPosition: Sit in a single-leg calf-raise machine with the front of the working foot centered on the platform and the lower thigh beneath the load pad.
execution.movement: Raise the heel as high as you can.
execution.endpoint: Finish at the highest heel position you can reach.
execution.returnPhase: Lower under control without straightening the knee or curling the toes.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the working knee bent near 90 degrees and hold the hip, pelvis, back, knee, and foot still.
execution.supportAndPosture: Sit tall on the machine seat with the load pad resting on your lower thigh.
disqualifyingCompensations: Straightening the knee turns the seated calf raise into a standing-style raise.
Curling the toes turns the calf raise into a toe-flexion exercise.
execution.sideOrDirection: Finish the set on the working side, then repeat with the other leg.

name: Bilateral Standing Shoulder-Pad Machine Calf Raise

execution.startingPosition: Stand in a two-leg calf-raise machine with both forefeet centered on the platform and both shoulders beneath the load pads. Compare the entered load only on this same machine.
execution.movement: Raise both heels together as high as you can.
execution.endpoint: Finish at the highest heel position you can reach with both knees straight.
execution.returnPhase: Lower both heels together under control without bending the knees or curling the toes.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep both knees straight and hold your hips, back, knees, and feet steady.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stand tall on the machine platform with the load pads resting on your shoulders.
disqualifyingCompensations: Moving one heel before the other leaves the simultaneous two-leg fixture.
Bending and straightening the knees turns the calf raise into a knee-driven bounce.
Curling the toes turns the calf raise into a toe-flexion exercise.

name: Bilateral Seated Thigh-Pad Machine Calf Raise

execution.startingPosition: Sit in a two-leg calf-raise machine with both forefeet centered on the platform, both knees bent near 90 degrees, and the lower thighs beneath the load pad. Compare the entered load only on this same machine.
execution.movement: Raise both heels together as high as you can.
execution.endpoint: Finish at the highest heel position you can reach while both knees remain bent.
execution.returnPhase: Lower both heels together under control without straightening the knees or curling the toes.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep both knees bent near 90 degrees and hold the hips, pelvis, back, knees, and feet still.
execution.supportAndPosture: Sit tall on the machine seat with the load pad resting on both lower thighs.
disqualifyingCompensations: Moving one heel before the other leaves the simultaneous two-leg fixture.
Straightening the knees turns the seated calf raise into a standing-style raise.
Curling the toes turns the calf raise into a toe-flexion exercise.

execution.startingPosition: Place both forearms on a stable floor with your elbows below your shoulders and your upper arms pointing straight down.
execution.movement: Support the lower body on both feet and align the spine, pelvis, hips, and knees in one neutral straight line.
execution.endpoint: Hold this position for the set time without letting your lower back sag.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the hold still without turning it into a crunch, hip lift, reach, or limb movement.
execution.supportAndPosture: Support the hold on both forearms and both feet with your trunk braced.
disqualifyingCompensations: Letting the lower back sag turns the plank into an arched-back hold.
Piking the hips upward turns the plank into a hip lift.
Reaching or lifting a limb turns the plank into a moving-limb hold.

execution.startingPosition: Lie on one side and support your body on that forearm, with both your shoulder and elbow at about 90 degrees. Straighten both legs, place the top foot in front of the lower foot, and place the free hand on the opposite shoulder.
execution.movement: Lift your body into a straight line from shoulder through hip to feet.
execution.endpoint: Hold the straight-line position for the set time.
execution.controlledJoints: Do not dip your hips or move your arms or legs during the hold.
execution.supportAndPosture: Support the hold on one forearm and both feet with your trunk braced.
disqualifyingCompensations: Letting the hips dip or sag turns the side plank into a bent-body hold.
Rolling the torso forward or backward turns the side plank into an anti-rotation hold.
execution.sideOrDirection: Repeat the hold on the other side.

execution.startingPosition: Attach a band to a side pulley so its line of pull is horizontal. Hold the handle in both hands at shoulder height. Choose a tension you can control.
execution.movement: Straighten both elbows until your arms point directly forward.
execution.endpoint: Hold for the set time without letting your torso or hips turn.
execution.controlledJoints: Do not repeatedly press your arms in and out.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stand side-on with the feet together on a stable floor.
disqualifyingCompensations: Bending and straightening the elbows turns the hold into a dynamic press.
Letting the torso or hips rotate turns the hold into a trunk-rotation drill.
Widening or staggering the feet turns the feet-together hold into a different balance test.
execution.sideOrDirection: Repeat with the anchor on the other side.

execution.startingPosition: Stand with your heels about hip-width apart and a straight barbell resting securely across your upper back. Hold the bar with both hands in an overhand grip.
execution.movement: Bend your hips and knees, letting your knees travel forward naturally.
execution.endpoint: End the descent when your upper thighs are about parallel to the floor.
execution.returnPhase: Drive through both feet and straighten your hips and knees to return to standing while keeping the bar controlled.
execution.controlledJoints: Do not deliberately round or arch your back to complete the repetition.
execution.supportAndPosture: Brace your torso and keep both feet planted.
disqualifyingCompensations: Sitting onto a box turns the squat into a box squat.
Bouncing at the bottom turns the squat into a rebound squat.
Driving the hips up faster than the chest turns the squat into a good morning.

execution.startingPosition: Stand with your heels about hip-width apart and support a straight barbell across the front of your shoulders and collarbones in a clean grip.
execution.movement: Bend your hips and knees, letting your knees travel forward naturally.
execution.endpoint: End the descent when your upper thighs are about parallel to the floor.
execution.returnPhase: Drive through both feet and straighten your hips and knees to return to standing while keeping the bar balanced on the front of your shoulders.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep your elbows lifted, and do not deliberately round or arch your back to complete the repetition.
execution.supportAndPosture: Brace your trunk and keep both feet planted.
disqualifyingCompensations: Sitting onto a support turns the squat into a box squat.
Bouncing at the bottom turns the squat into a rebound squat.
Dropping the elbows tips the torso forward and turns the front squat into a good morning.

execution.startingPosition: Stand with both feet about shoulder-width apart and hold one kettlebell vertically at your chest by its horns.
execution.movement: Sit the hips down and back while bending both knees and keeping the kettlebell close to the chest.
execution.endpoint: Stop when the upper thighs are approximately parallel to the floor.
execution.returnPhase: Drive through both feet and extend the hips, knees, and ankles to stand tall with the kettlebell still at the chest.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the knees tracking with the feet and the elbows under control without turning the movement into a press.
execution.supportAndPosture: Brace the trunk, keep both feet planted, and use no external torso support.
disqualifyingCompensations: Lowering the kettlebell away from the chest changes the reviewed goblet fixture.
Stopping above thigh-parallel depth changes the reviewed range.
Pressing the kettlebell overhead adds an upper-body prime action.

execution.startingPosition: Use the reviewed vertical-rail Smith setup, place the bar across the upper back, and stand with both feet shoulder-width apart directly under the bar line with zero forward or backward offset. Log the entered machine load and compare it only on the same fixture.
execution.movement: Unlock the bar and bend the hips and knees while following the vertical rail path.
execution.endpoint: Stop when the upper thighs are approximately parallel to the floor.
execution.returnPhase: Drive through both feet and extend the hips, knees, and ankles to return to standing along the same vertical path.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep both knees tracking with the feet and do not shift the stance away from the bar line.
execution.supportAndPosture: Brace the trunk, keep both feet planted, and retain the upper-back bar position.
disqualifyingCompensations: Moving the feet forward or backward changes the reviewed zero-offset geometry.
Using angled rails changes the reviewed machine fixture.
Placing the bar on the front of the shoulders changes the reviewed load position.

execution.startingPosition: Lie on your back on a flat bench with one dumbbell over each shoulder, your palms facing each other, and your elbows held in a fixed slight bend.
execution.movement: Lower the upper arms outward at shoulder height.
execution.endpoint: End with the upper arms lowered out to the sides at shoulder height.
execution.returnPhase: Sweep your upper arms together until the dumbbells meet over your chest without pressing, changing the elbow bend, or deliberately reaching your shoulder blades forward.
execution.controlledJoints: Hold your elbows in a fixed slight bend.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep your back supported on the flat bench and your torso still.
disqualifyingCompensations: Bending and straightening the elbows turns the fly into a dumbbell press.
Arching the back or lifting the hips to heave the dumbbells turns the fly into a full-body heave.

execution.startingPosition: Stand between the anchored ends of an elastic band with the upper arms held at shoulder height, the palms facing inward, and the elbows in a fixed slight bend.
execution.movement: Sweep your upper arms together until your hands meet in front of your chest.
execution.endpoint: End the sweep when your hands meet in front of your chest.
execution.returnPhase: Return under control without pressing, changing the elbow bend, or deliberately reaching your shoulder blades forward.
execution.controlledJoints: Hold your elbows in a fixed slight bend.
execution.supportAndPosture: Brace your torso while standing between the anchored band ends.
disqualifyingCompensations: Bending and straightening the elbows turns the fly into a band press.
Leaning or twisting the torso to swing the hands together turns the fly into a full-body heave.

execution.startingPosition: Set both towers to head level with the same load on each stack, hold one handle per side, stand centered in a lunge stance, and lean forward with a fixed slight elbow bend.
execution.movement: Bring both arms together in front while keeping the arms and cables in the same plane.
execution.endpoint: End when the hands meet in front without crossing past each other.
execution.returnPhase: Open the arms under control to the sideways start without changing the elbow bend.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep both elbows slightly bent and move the arms symmetrically.
execution.supportAndPosture: Hold the lunge stance and forward torso position without stepping or twisting.
disqualifyingCompensations: Bending and straightening the elbows changes the fly into a cable press.
Stepping, twisting, or allowing one side to lead changes the reviewed balanced path.

execution.startingPosition: Sit against the back pad, adjust the seat so both handles align with the chest, and take one handle in each hand with a fixed slight elbow bend. Log the entered machine load and compare it only on this same fixture.
execution.movement: Bring both handled levers inward together by sweeping the upper arms across the chest.
execution.endpoint: Finish when the handles meet at the machine's controlled end position without pressing through the elbows.
execution.returnPhase: Let both levers open under control to the starting position while keeping the elbow angle fixed.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the wrists neutral, elbows slightly bent, and both sides moving simultaneously.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep the torso against the posterior pad and the feet stable throughout the set.
disqualifyingCompensations: Bending and straightening the elbows turns the fly into a press.
Leaving the back pad to create momentum changes the reviewed supported fixture.
Using upper-arm pads instead of handles changes the load interface and family.

execution.startingPosition: Place a free straight barbell on the floor. Stand in a symmetric medium stance about one pelvis-width apart with a comfortable foot angle. Take a double-overhand grip with both arms outside your thighs and keep both feet planted.
execution.movement: From the floor-contact position, push through both feet and straighten your hips and knees together while the bar rises in your extended arms. Let the ankles move naturally toward the standing angle without rising onto your toes.
execution.endpoint: Finish upright with your hips and knees extended and the bar controlled in both hands.
execution.returnPhase: Bend your hips and knees under control and lower the bar until the plates contact the floor. Let the plates touch without assuming a prescribed pause, reset, or complete unloading between repetitions.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep both elbows extended and brace your trunk without deliberately rounding or arching to create the repetition.
execution.supportAndPosture: Use no external torso support, keep the free bar controlled, and maintain continuous contact through both feet.
disqualifyingCompensations: Moving the feet wide and placing the arms inside the thighs turns the lift into a sumo deadlift.
Keeping the knees nearly straight turns the floor pull into a stiff-leg deadlift.
Using a hexagonal bar changes the handle and load geometry into a trap-bar deadlift.
Deliberately rounding the spine to move the bar turns the lift into a rounded-back pull outside this contract.

execution.startingPosition: Secure the legs on a bench declined 15 degrees, and lie with the eyes below the racked bar.
execution.movement: Press the bar up while keeping your torso and shoulders supported.
execution.endpoint: Finish with your elbows straight.
execution.returnPhase: Lower the bar under control toward the lower-chest line.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep your torso and shoulders supported against the bench throughout the press.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stay anchored on the decline bench with your legs secured.
disqualifyingCompensations: Bouncing the bar off the chest turns the press into a rebound.
Lifting the shoulders or torso off the bench turns the supported press into an unsupported press.

execution.startingPosition: Secure the legs on a bench declined 15 degrees, and begin with one dumbbell beside each lower-chest line.
execution.movement: Keep each forearm beneath its dumbbell, and press upward and slightly inward.
execution.endpoint: Finish with your elbows straight.
execution.returnPhase: Lower the dumbbells under control without turning the repetition into a fly.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep each forearm stacked beneath its dumbbell and your torso and shoulders supported.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stay anchored on the decline bench with your legs secured.
disqualifyingCompensations: Letting the dumbbells drift wide apart turns the press into a fly.
Lifting the shoulders or torso off the bench turns the supported press into an unsupported press.

execution.startingPosition: Set a decline bench to 15 degrees, and position it so the Smith bar descends toward the lower chest without forcing the shoulders forward.
execution.movement: Press the bar along the rails while keeping your torso and shoulders supported.
execution.endpoint: Finish with your elbows straight.
execution.returnPhase: Lower the bar along the rails under control.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep your torso and shoulders supported against the bench throughout the press.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stay anchored on the decline bench with your legs secured.
disqualifyingCompensations: Bouncing the bar off the chest turns the press into a rebound.
Lifting the shoulders or torso off the bench turns the supported press into an unsupported press.

execution.startingPosition: Adjust the seat so the handles begin beside the lower chest and follow an approximately 15-degree downward path relative to a horizontal press.
execution.movement: Keep your torso against the pad, and press the handles forward and inward.
execution.endpoint: Finish with your elbows straight.
execution.returnPhase: Return under control.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep your torso and shoulders supported against the pad throughout the press.
execution.supportAndPosture: Sit anchored against the machine pad with your feet settled.
disqualifyingCompensations: Lifting the torso off the pad turns the supported press into an unsupported press.
Shrugging the shoulders forward turns the decline press into a shrug-assisted push.

execution.startingPosition: Sit on a flat bench facing a high cable with both feet on the floor and no thigh restraint. Hold the straight bar wider than shoulder width with your palms facing forward, straighten your elbows, and point your arms upward at about 45 degrees. Log the cable weight you actually use rather than the suggested starting weight of 35 lb or 15 kg; this exercise was tested with weights equal to 10% and 25% of body weight.
execution.movement: Pull the bar to your chest, driving your elbows down and back.
execution.endpoint: End the pull when the bar touches your chest.
execution.returnPhase: Return slowly to the same 45-degree start without pulling your arms across your body, twisting, leaning to propel the bar, or using your lower body.
execution.controlledJoints: Allow your shoulder blades to move naturally instead of deliberately pinching or rotating them.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep your head straight and your core tight.
disqualifyingCompensations: Twisting or leaning to propel the bar turns the diagonal pull into a full-body heave.
Pulling the bar horizontally toward the waist turns the diagonal pull into a seated row.
Starting with the arms pointing straight overhead turns the diagonal pull into a vertical pulldown.

execution.startingPosition: Support the full body above fixed dip bars with no foot contact.
execution.movement: Bend your elbows and lower under control, letting your upper arms move slightly behind your torso.
execution.endpoint: End the descent only as far as feels comfortable.
execution.returnPhase: Press back up until your elbows are straight.
execution.controlledJoints: Do not swing, kick, or force your shoulder blades into a specific position.
execution.supportAndPosture: Hold your torso steady above the bars with your trunk braced.
disqualifyingCompensations: Swinging or kicking the legs turns the dip into a kipping dip.
Pushing through the feet turns the dip into an assisted dip.

execution.startingPosition: Support the full body above two independent rings with no foot contact.
execution.movement: Bend your elbows and lower, letting your upper arms move slightly behind you.
execution.endpoint: End the descent only as far as feels comfortable.
execution.returnPhase: Press back up until your elbows are straight.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the rings controlled beside your torso without kipping or using your legs.
execution.supportAndPosture: Hold your torso steady between the rings with your trunk braced.
disqualifyingCompensations: Kipping or driving with the legs turns the ring dip into a muscle-up attempt.
Letting the rings swing away from your torso turns the dip into an unstable support hold.

execution.startingPosition: Stand upright with both feet supporting you and cross your arms over your upper body.
execution.movement: Step forward with the selected lead foot and land with the whole foot in contact, then lower under control for three seconds.
execution.endpoint: Stop the descent at your full self-selected depth.
execution.returnPhase: Keep the lead foot planted as you straighten the lead hip and knee and rise toward standing over two seconds, then step the lead foot back beside the other foot to complete the repetition.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the lead foot fully planted through the descent and rise.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stay upright with your arms crossed and no external support.
disqualifyingCompensations: Pushing off the rear foot to stand turns the lunge into a rear-leg push-off.
Dropping straight down in place turns the step-and-return lunge into a stationary split squat.
Letting the lead heel lift turns the lunge into a toe-balanced stance.
execution.sideOrDirection: Finish the set on the selected side, then repeat with the other lead leg.

execution.startingPosition: Stand upright with both feet supporting you and cross your arms over your upper body.
execution.movement: Keep the selected front foot planted and step the opposite foot backward. After the rear foot lands, lower under control for three seconds without moving the selected front foot.
execution.endpoint: Stop the descent at your full self-selected depth.
execution.returnPhase: Straighten the selected front hip and knee and rise toward standing over two seconds, then bring the rear foot forward beside the front foot.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the selected front foot planted through the descent and rise.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stay upright with your arms crossed and no external support.
disqualifyingCompensations: Pushing off the rear foot to stand turns the lunge into a rear-leg push-off.
Dropping straight down in place turns the step-and-return lunge into a stationary split squat.
Letting the front heel lift turns the lunge into a toe-balanced stance.
execution.sideOrDirection: Finish the set with the same selected front leg, then repeat on the other side.

execution.startingPosition: Stand at a high cable, and hold a single handle with the working palm facing up. Compare the entered load only on this same cable station and attachment.
execution.movement: Straighten the elbow from about 90 degrees.
execution.endpoint: End the pushdown with your elbow fully straight.
execution.returnPhase: Return under control without moving the shoulder or rotating the forearm.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the upper arm alongside your torso and the wrist straight.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stand upright with your feet planted and your trunk braced.
disqualifyingCompensations: Letting the upper arm drift away from the torso turns the pushdown into an overhead extension.
Rotating the forearm during the push turns the palm-up pushdown into a palm-down pushdown.
execution.sideOrDirection: Finish the set with one arm, then repeat with the other arm.

execution.startingPosition: Stand at a high cable, and hold a single handle with the working palm facing down. Compare the entered load only on this same cable station and attachment.
execution.movement: Straighten the elbow from about 90 degrees.
execution.endpoint: End the pushdown with your elbow fully straight.
execution.returnPhase: Return under control without moving the shoulder or rotating the forearm.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the upper arm alongside your torso and the wrist straight.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stand upright with your feet planted and your trunk braced.
disqualifyingCompensations: Letting the upper arm drift away from the torso turns the pushdown into an overhead extension.
Rotating the forearm during the push turns the palm-down pushdown into a palm-up pushdown.
execution.sideOrDirection: Finish the set with one arm, then repeat with the other arm.

execution.startingPosition: Stand with one arm overhead and the palm facing up while the cable pulls against you. Compare the entered load only on this same cable station and attachment.
execution.movement: Straighten the elbow from about 90 degrees.
execution.endpoint: End the extension with your elbow fully straight.
execution.returnPhase: Return under control.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep your upper arm, wrist, torso, and lower body still.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stand upright with your feet planted and your trunk braced.
disqualifyingCompensations: Dropping the upper arm to your side turns the overhead extension into a pushdown.
Arching the back to move the handle turns the overhead extension into a back-assisted press.
execution.sideOrDirection: Finish the set with one arm, then repeat with the other arm.

name: Seated Single-Arm Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension

execution.startingPosition: Sit upright without back support, and hold one dumbbell overhead with your palm facing inward.
execution.movement: Bend the elbow to lower the dumbbell.
execution.endpoint: End the lowering with the dumbbell at the bottom of the repetition.
execution.returnPhase: Straighten the elbow as far as you can without turning the forearm.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep your upper arm and torso still.
execution.supportAndPosture: Support yourself on the seat with your trunk braced and no back support.
disqualifyingCompensations: Dropping the upper arm to your side turns the overhead extension into a pushdown.
Turning the forearm while straightening turns the extension into a forearm rotation.
execution.sideOrDirection: Finish the set with one arm, then repeat with the other arm.

execution.startingPosition: Lie on your back on a bench with one dumbbell held over your chest, your palm facing inward, and your upper arm pointing straight up.
execution.movement: Bend the elbow to lower the dumbbell.
execution.endpoint: End the lowering with the dumbbell at the bottom of the repetition.
execution.returnPhase: Straighten the elbow as far as you can.
execution.controlledJoints: Hold your upper arm still.
execution.supportAndPosture: Support your torso fully on the bench.
disqualifyingCompensations: Letting the upper arm fall toward your torso turns the lying extension into a close-grip press.
Tilting the upper arm back overhead turns the lying extension into an overhead extension.
execution.sideOrDirection: Finish the set with one arm, then repeat with the other arm.

execution.startingPosition: Stand at the high cable holding the straight bar with both palms down at shoulder width, keep the upper arms close to the torso, and lean slightly forward. Compare the entered load only on this same cable station and attachment.
execution.movement: Move only the forearms downward until both elbows reach full extension.
execution.endpoint: End with both elbows fully straight and the bar clear of the torso.
execution.returnPhase: Return through the full range while preserving the same upper-arm and torso positions.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the upper arms perpendicular to the floor and the wrists neutral.
execution.supportAndPosture: Maintain the slight forward lean without using bodyweight to drive the bar.
disqualifyingCompensations: Leaning onto the bar changes the strict pushdown into a bodyweight-assisted push.
Moving the upper arms or allowing one arm to lead changes the reviewed two-arm elbow extension.

execution.startingPosition: Stand upright facing a cable set above your head. Hold one rope end in each hand with a neutral grip, brace your trunk, and keep both upper arms beside the torso. Compare the entered load only on this same cable station and attachment.
execution.movement: Extend both elbows together and press the rope toward the floor.
execution.endpoint: Finish with both elbows straight but not forcefully locked and the wrists still neutral.
execution.returnPhase: Allow both elbows to flex together under control until the upper arms would begin to drift forward.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the shoulders, upper arms, forearms, and wrists in their starting alignment while the elbows move.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep the torso vertical and do not lean bodyweight onto the rope.
disqualifyingCompensations: Moving the upper arms forward turns the pushdown into a shoulder-driven cable movement.
Leaning onto the rope changes the strict pushdown into a bodyweight-assisted push.
Moving one arm before the other leaves the simultaneous two-arm fixture.

execution.startingPosition: Stand facing a low cable while holding a straight bar with both palms facing up.
execution.movement: Bend your elbows as far as you can.
execution.endpoint: End each repetition with your elbows bent as far as they comfortably go.
execution.returnPhase: Lower the bar under control without turning your forearms.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep your upper arms beside your torso and your wrists straight.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep your body still.
disqualifyingCompensations: Swinging the upper arms forward turns the strict curl into a shoulder swing.
Leaning the torso backward turns the strict curl into a cheat curl.
Letting the palms turn away from facing up changes the palms-up curl into a different grip exercise.

execution.startingPosition: Stand facing a low cable while holding the rope ends with both palms facing inward.
execution.movement: Bend your elbows as far as you can.
execution.endpoint: End each repetition with your elbows bent as far as they comfortably go.
execution.returnPhase: Return under control without turning your forearms.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep your upper arms beside your torso and your wrists straight.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep your body still.
disqualifyingCompensations: Swinging the upper arms forward turns the strict curl into a shoulder swing.
Leaning the torso backward turns the strict curl into a cheat curl.
Turning the palms away from facing each other changes the hammer curl into a different grip exercise.

execution.startingPosition: Stand facing a low cable while holding a straight bar with both palms facing down.
execution.movement: Bend your elbows as far as you can.
execution.endpoint: End each repetition with your elbows bent as far as they comfortably go.
execution.returnPhase: Lower the bar under control without turning your forearms.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep your upper arms beside your torso and your wrists straight.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep your body still.
disqualifyingCompensations: Swinging the upper arms forward turns the strict curl into a shoulder swing.
Leaning the torso backward turns the strict curl into a cheat curl.
Letting the palms turn away from facing down changes the reverse curl into a different grip exercise.

execution.startingPosition: Stand upright holding the straight bar with both palms facing up and the upper arms beside the torso.
execution.movement: Flex both elbows through a comfortable full range without moving the shoulders.
execution.endpoint: End with the elbows comfortably bent and both palms still facing up.
execution.returnPhase: Lower the bar under control without rotating the forearms.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the wrists neutral and the upper arms beside the torso.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep the trunk and knees still throughout the repetition.
disqualifyingCompensations: Leaning backward or driving with the knees changes the strict curl.
Swinging the upper arms forward adds a shoulder-flexion repetition.

execution.startingPosition: Stand with one dumbbell in the working hand, the palm facing up, and the upper arm alongside the body.
execution.movement: Flex the working elbow through a comfortable range without moving the shoulder.
execution.endpoint: End with the elbow comfortably flexed and the palm still facing up.
execution.returnPhase: Lower the dumbbell under control toward the near-extended start.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the palm up, wrist neutral, and upper arm beside the torso.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep the trunk and lower body still against the one-sided load.
disqualifyingCompensations: Leaning or twisting the torso changes the strict curl.
Swinging the upper arm forward or rotating the palm changes the reviewed fixture.
execution.sideOrDirection: Complete the set on one arm, then repeat with the other arm.

execution.startingPosition: Sit at a preacher station with both upper arms fully supported on the pad, hold the source-described bar with palms up, and keep the wrists neutral.
execution.movement: Flex both elbows together for one second without lifting the upper arms from the pad.

execution.startingPosition: Sit in the pulldown machine with your thighs secured beneath the pad, and hold the overhead handles with your palms facing each other.
execution.movement: Drive both elbows down as the levers follow their guided path.
execution.endpoint: End the pull when both elbows are fully driven down.
execution.returnPhase: Return to full overhead reach under control.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the lower body still beneath the secured thigh pad.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep the torso braced with your thighs secured beneath the pad.
disqualifyingCompensations: Leaning back to drag the levers down turns the machine pulldown into a seated row.
Rocking the torso to move the levers turns the machine pulldown into a full-body heave.

execution.startingPosition: Sit in the single-arm pulldown machine with your thighs secured, and hold one overhead handle with your palm facing inward.
execution.movement: Drive the working elbow down.
execution.endpoint: End the pull with the working elbow fully down.
execution.returnPhase: Return the lever overhead under control.
execution.controlledJoints: Do not rotate or lean during the pull.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep the torso and pelvis square with your thighs secured.
disqualifyingCompensations: Rotating the torso to swing the elbow down turns the single-arm pulldown into a twisting row.
Leaning the torso to move the lever turns the single-arm pulldown into a full-body heave.

execution.startingPosition: Log one dumbbell's weight, not the pair total. Stand tall with one matching dumbbell beside each thigh and room to travel forward.
execution.movement: Step forward with one leg, lower under control into a split stance, then drive through the lead foot and carry the trail leg directly into the next forward step.
execution.endpoint: Finish each repetition as the opposite foot lands ahead to begin the next lunge; do not stop in a feet-together stance.
execution.returnPhase: Continue forward by alternating lead legs for the prescribed repetitions.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the dumbbells still, wrists neutral, trunk braced, and each lead knee tracking over the foot.
execution.supportAndPosture: Use no hand support and do not push the dumbbells with body swing.
disqualifyingCompensations: Returning to feet-together standing after every step turns the task into step-and-return lunges.
Repeating one lead leg leaves the alternating walking fixture.
Jumping between stances turns the exercise into a jumping lunge.
execution.sideOrDirection: Alternate lead legs continuously while traveling forward; count each completed step as one repetition.

execution.startingPosition: Place your back flat against a wall with both feet fully planted about shoulder-width apart and positioned in front of you.
execution.movement: Slide down until the thighs are approximately horizontal and the hips and knees are each near ninety degrees.
execution.endpoint: Hold that position for the recorded duration while maintaining the wall and floor contacts.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the hips, knees, ankles, feet, pelvis, and spine steady without sliding.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep the full back against the wall and both whole feet on the floor.
disqualifyingCompensations: Sliding materially above or below the reviewed range changes the fixture.
Losing wall contact or lifting part of either foot removes the reviewed support.

execution.startingPosition: Sit astride a flat bench with both forearms supported, palms facing down, and your hands just beyond the edge. Hold a straight bar without opening your fingers.
execution.movement: Lift both hands as far as you can with control.
execution.endpoint: Finish with both hands lifted as far as they comfortably go.
execution.returnPhase: Lower under control.
execution.controlledJoints: Do not rotate the forearms or move the elbows, shoulders, or torso.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stay seated astride the bench with both forearms supported on its surface.
disqualifyingCompensations: Bending the elbows to lift the bar turns the reverse wrist curl into a reverse curl.
Twisting the forearms to swing the bar up turns the wrist curl into a forearm rotation.

execution.startingPosition: Sit astride a flat bench with both forearms supported, palms facing up, and your hands just beyond the edge. Hold a straight bar without opening the fingers.
execution.movement: Curl both hands upward as far as you can with control.
execution.endpoint: Stop at the top when your wrists are fully curled.
execution.returnPhase: Lower the bar under control.
execution.controlledJoints: Do not rotate the forearms or move the elbows, shoulders, or torso.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep both forearms supported on the bench throughout the set.
disqualifyingCompensations: Opening the fingers and rolling the bar turns the wrist curl into a finger curl.
Lifting the forearms off the bench turns the wrist curl into an unsupported curl.

execution.startingPosition: Stand tall with your working arm beside your body, your elbow straight, and your thumb pointing forward. Grip below the dumbbell's bottom collar with its shaft pointing ahead.
execution.movement: Raise the thumb side of your wrist through the controlled available range.
execution.endpoint: End the lift at the top of the controlled available range.
execution.returnPhase: Lower under control without rotating your forearm or moving your elbow, shoulder, or torso.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep your elbow straight and your working arm beside your body.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stand tall and keep your torso still.
disqualifyingCompensations: Bending the elbow to swing the dumbbell turns the wrist deviation into an arm curl.
Rotating the forearm during the lift turns the thumb-side deviation into a forearm rotation.
Gripping the dumbbell at its center turns the collar-offset lever into a plain dumbbell hold.
execution.sideOrDirection: Complete all repetitions on one side, then repeat with the other hand.

execution.startingPosition: Stand tall with your working arm beside your body, your elbow straight, and your thumb pointing forward. Grip just above the dumbbell's bottom collar with its shaft pointing behind.
execution.movement: Raise the little-finger side of the wrist.
execution.endpoint: Stop at the end of your controlled available range.
execution.returnPhase: Lower without rotating the forearm or moving the elbow, shoulder, or torso.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the forearm, elbow, shoulder, and torso still while the wrist moves.

disqualifyingCompensations: Rotating the forearm turns the wrist deviation into a forearm rotation.
